classification_notes: This season was extracted from the downloaded Manchester United Football Club Limited Companies House filing. The turnover note again discloses Commercial, Broadcasting and Matchday directly, but the commercial line remains materially narrower than the broader plc commercial segment used in later seasons.
women_team_treatment_notes: Women's team revenue is not separately disclosed in the source used here.
non_football_revenue_notes: The turnover note states turnover derives from the company's principal activities in the United Kingdom. No separate non-football revenue adjustment was identified within the club-limited turnover note used here.
source_document: Manchester United Football Club Limited annual report and financial statements for the year ended 30 June 2015
notes: Scanned PDF extraction. Debt is not disclosed as a single company net-debt line, so net debt has been estimated as fellow-subsidiary senior secured notes plus secured term loan less company cash at bank and in hand.
